purpose: Teach: フライパン/ティーン/ステッカー/サボっ/つぼみ/吠え/きゅう/じわじわ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさんの、絶対、フライパン料理、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、大好きだったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, you absolutely loved your grandmother's pan-fried dishes. Do you remember? I'm being serious.
lines.style: Gentle, searching tone. Slow, measured pace. Voice softens on memories. Slight lift at the question mark—seeking confirmation, not pressing. Warm nostalgia underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。孫、本気で、絶対、もう、絶対、ティーンになって、絶対、大きくなったわよね、あなた
lines.en: Yes. And you became such a big boy, turning into a teenager before we knew it, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Soft, affirming voice. Slight warmth and wonder on 'became such a big boy'—time's passage catching her. Gentle cadence, nodding along with her own words. Intimate, unspeeding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんが、本気で、絶対、孫のために、絶対、ステッカー、絶対、買ってあげたって、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Your grandfather bought stickers for you, remember? He did that for his grandchild. Do you recall?
lines.style: Voice brightens on the memory. Tender concentration on the small kindness. Searching, not accusatory. Pauses for her to meet him in the remembering. Quiet pride underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、お仕事、絶対、サボったこと、絶対、なかったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, your grandfather never once skipped work. You remember that about him, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Steady, almost matter-of-fact pride. Not boastful—stating a simple truth with respect. Slight warmth on 'dear.' Pause before the question, letting the fact settle first.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 庭の梅、本気で、絶対、つぼみ、絶対、もう、絶対、ふくらんできたわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: The plum blossoms in the garden—the buds are already swelling now. Do you see it, Sachiko? You remember springs like that?
lines.style: Alert, present-moment attention. Voice lifts slightly on noticing the buds. Gentle, observational pace. Inviting her to see with him, not telling her. Quiet wonder.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、飼ってた犬、絶対、夜中も、絶対、よく、絶対、吠えたわよね、あなた、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, that dog we kept would bark in the middle of the night, wouldn't it? You remember how it was, don't you?
lines.style: Nostalgic, almost amused. Voice lilts slightly on the barking—a small smile underneath. Not complaining, just remembering the liveliness of it all. Warm and accepting tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔、本気で、絶対、きゅうに、絶対、雨が、絶対、降ってきた時、絶対、二人で、絶対、雨宿りしたわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Years ago, when the rain came suddenly like that, we sheltered together. The two of us. Do you remember that, Sachiko?
lines.style: Tender, intimate delivery. Voice softens and slows on 'sheltered together.' Pause before 'the two of us'—letting that simple fact breathe. Quiet, precious memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 最近、本気で、絶対、じわじわと、絶対、年、絶対、感じてきたわよね、あなた、お互いに、健康、第一にしましょうね
lines.en: Lately, I've been feeling time more and more. You feel it too, don't you? Let's keep our health first, you and me. For each other.
lines.style: Gentle but grounded. Slower pace on 'feeling time.' Voice settles into quiet practicality on 'keep our health first'—not anxious, just clear priority. Tender close, hand-reaching.
